write_up: You’re a product designer from Brightpath Studio and Loop Fitness, now working at Ferry Street Coffee. It’s common for design resumes to list deliverables without explaining the decisions behind them. For product design roles, that makes it harder to stand out because a recruiter can’t tell how you approached the work.

The Loop Fitness design system is your best model: you name what you created, that it was the app’s first, and the tool you used. Your current café role accounts for your recent work; the product design roles ended earlier, so a recruiter will also look to your portfolio for your design work.

Let’s start with the Loop Fitness booking flow. Add the problem you were solving and the design choices you made, then do the same for the testing and release work. If you’ve done more recent design projects, date and describe those honestly too.
